title: European Crash Retrieval Initiative and its cold case
summary: Beatriz Villarroel tells of European Crash Retrieval Initiative and its cold case, about present at Europe (led from Sweden), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We are working on a cold case that I cannot go into details on, but it's super cool, super scary.

plain: An astronomer, Beatriz Villarroel, says she leads from Sweden a European group meant to look into crash retrievals, meaning the recovery of crashed craft that might not be human-made. She says the group is working on an old unsolved case that she cannot describe, calling it super cool and super scary. If true, it would mean scientists in Europe are chasing a real crash of something unknown.
